card.title: The Expert Blind Spot
card.instruction: Perform mastery everywhere except one specific subject. Deflect it at first, reinterpret it later, and let each return increase the pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain every clause in this lease except the one about renewal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we should give it the benefit of a thorough introduction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A deceptively advanced word. Let's revisit 'lease' first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've explained the deposit and repairs in your lease. Renewal can wait.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Renewal is why I brought it. Do I need to do anything?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's establish your excellent grasp of the deposit first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says 'renews automatically.' I'm calling the landlord now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put me on speaker. 'Automatically' describes a process, and I'll need him to define his terms.

mechanism: A performs lease mastery while avoiding renewal, then reinterprets its plain wording when the landlord is about to be called.
confusable: Unlike merely asking for expert help, A must preserve mastery by recasting the subject after initial deflection.
comparison: S219-b joins an external call as terminology arbiter; S219-a reframes a START label to keep lecturing.
